findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "tripsy_activities_create" is 1888 chars, far longer than this server's median (374). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "tripsy_documents_upload_prepare" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
